neko_client.config.comment.searchBox:
Shows a search box on top of the Void Warehouse screen.
Match by name, pinyin, initials or registry id. Turning this off also stops the catalog request.
neko_client.config.comment.fillCombo:
Hold this, then click a slot in the first 5 content rows to withdraw until
your inventory can hold no more (row 6 is navigation; your own inventory and
hotbar are not fill targets). Combo = exactly one mouse button + any of
Shift / Ctrl / Alt. Since 0.4.7 the default is Ctrl+Alt+right click (BUTTON_2);
for left click change the mouse button to BUTTON_1, middle is BUTTON_3.
Only these three modifiers work on the keyboard side - Vanilla exposes only
their state; binding a letter/number key marks the combo as unusable (the join
log says why). Matching is strict with no button-code tolerance: binding right
never triggers on left, and vice versa. The verdict log states the clicked and
the bound key code; a wrong region is reported as inventory / hotbar / nav row.
Empty = off.
neko_client.config.comment.silenceChat:
When on, this client discards every chat message sent by the Void Warehouse: the [Void Warehouse] / [虚空仓库] prefixes and the unprefixed recipe-book continuation lines starting with the corner mark.
Display only - the server still sends them and other players still see them; messages already in the chat history are kept. Off by default.
neko_client.config.comment.warehouseTake:
Hold an item and press this hotkey to withdraw the same item from the Void Warehouse into your inventory, until it can hold no more.
No warehouse screen needed. Requires carpet-Neko-Addition 1.0.17+ on the server with voidWarehouse and voidWarehouseRestock both enabled. Unbound by default.
neko_client.config.comment.openRecipes:
Opens the recipe-book browser: every entry as "output x count <- ingredients", each deletable (two taps, shared by the whole server, no undo).
Requires the void warehouse screen to be open and carpet-Neko-Addition 1.0.17+ on the server.
neko_client.config.comment.openGui: Opens this mod's config screen (toggles and hotkeys live there).
